L5 WHAT THIS CHANGES, AND WHAT IT DOES NOT
CHANGES: 'does context matter?' is not a question this target can answer. Double-
centring forces the answer to yes before any network exists. Loop 257's I3 and
loop 256's H4 both asked it, and both comparisons were degenerate by construction,
not merely under-trained. Defect H's remedy -- train the control harder -- is
useless here; no amount of capacity reaches a variance component that is absent.
The answerable question is whether context is used in a way that TRANSFERS to a
line never seen, which is what a wrong-line control and an out-of-sample blend
weight actually test.
DOES NOT CHANGE: loop 257's I2. The gated model still loses 0.0152 to the additive

DOES NOT CHANGE: the 19.5% is measured on held-out ROWS from lines the model
trained on. It is real three-way structure, and it still transfers negatively.
The gap between those two facts is the whole problem, stated precisely.
This is algebra about the TARGET, not a claim about biology. A different target --
the raw profile, or a residual centred differently -- has different geometry.
